newsitem.title: USA: Conn.Board of Ed to weigh charter school proposals.
newsitem.headline: Conn.Board of Ed to weigh charter school proposals.

text.p: Connecticut's Board of Education will hear proposals for 29 charter schools on Friday, as the debate of the racial balance in the state's public schools continues.
The board has been given the go-ahead to grant as many as 12 state charters and 12 local charters throughout the state. Charter schools would allow students to enter specialized courses of study.
